[[File:Beetlecollection.png|thumb|A collection of different beetles.]]
'''Beetles''' were a type of [[Insect/Legends|insect]]. Types of beetles included [[Swamp Beetle]]s,<ref name="TGoF">{{StoryCite|story=The Guardian of Forever!|book=Star Wars Weekly 113}}</ref> [[Clip beetle/Legends|clip beetles]],<ref name="Traitor">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref> and [[buzz-beetle]]s.<ref name="Battle Surgeons">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>

{{Creature-stub}}
